payout_quote: Miami Clinical Research, Diabetes Clinical Trials in Miami – Now Enrolling Participants: "Compensation (up to $3,500 or more depending on the study)". Free access to investigational diabetes treatments, regular checkups, lab work, and specialist monitoring. No insurance required or out-of-pocket costs.
steps: Open the Miami Clinical Research diabetes trials page and fill out the enrollment form (or call) to have their coordinators get you started.
Attend the free screening visit: confirm you are 18+, diagnosed with type 2 diabetes or prediabetes (A1C typically 7.0-10.5%), and meet the study-specific inclusion/exclusion criteria.
Enroll and complete the diabetes study visits: free study medication, medical exams, lab work, and specialist monitoring are provided at no cost.
Receive the study compensation (up to $3,500 or more depending on the study).
catches: Only adults 18+ with type 2 diabetes or prediabetes (typically A1C 7.0-10.5%) can participate, and you must pass the free screening — not everyone qualifies.
The "up to $3,500" figure is a ceiling for completing the study ("or more depending on the study" — amounts vary by study); no floor is stated.
You may receive investigational diabetes treatments with real medical risks and side effects.
A multi-visit study requires a real time commitment: free screening plus repeated on-site clinic visits in Miami, Florida over weeks/months.
Study availability changes over time; contact their team to confirm current enrollment. This page was indexed ~36 days before verification and may not reflect today's open studies.
The official listing does not state the exact visit schedule or visit count, so the total time above is an estimate — the actual time commitment could be higher.
biggest_catch: The $3,500 is an "up to" ceiling for completing a multi-visit diabetes study in Miami — you must be diagnosed with type 2 diabetes/prediabetes, pass screening (not everyone qualifies), and accept real medical risks from investigational treatments.
eligibility: 18+, diagnosed with type 2 diabetes or prediabetes, A1C typically 7.0-10.5%, on oral medications/insulin/lifestyle management, not pregnant or breastfeeding, able to attend clinic visits in Miami; must pass free screening.
timing: Compensation is paid for participating in/completing the study; study-related medication, exams, and lab work are at no cost; no insurance or out-of-pocket costs.
